assets.name: 星云粒子
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production desktop wallpaper, one single full-bleed landscape image, approximately 16:9. Input image: design reference only for background scenery, color palette, and atmosphere. Reconstruct ONLY the natural scenery behind the mock interface across the ENTIRE canvas. 淡蓝、淡紫、珍珠白柔雾星云，右上方柔和银河旋涡，多层蓬松云海，多个半透明淡色星球与细小星尘。重点是柔雾和球体空间层次。 Match the reference's luminous light blue/cyan/lavender atmosphere, slightly softened for readable desktop content. Rebuild the areas obscured by the UI as continuous natural scenery. Do not crop out most of the picture, do not blur away the UI into a rectangular patch. Calm central content area; focal scenery at edges. Absolutely NO text of any language, numbers, lettering, slogans, My Workspace, windows, panels, cards, borders, buttons, icons, input boxes, watermark, frame or collage anywhere. No interface, no mockup, no poster. Deliver one pure background scene only.
assets.visual_review: Pure scenery; no mock window, text, cards or controls. Reviewed separately against its reference.
